verdict.line: You lose only if you stand and out-spin Garen's full Judgment (E) duration or dive him below ~40% HP while his Demacian Justice (R) is up; you win nearly every short trade from level 3 onward.

brief.thesis: Sett's Knuckle Down (Q) into Facebreaker (E) burst combo deletes a chunk of HP faster than Garen's Perseverance passive can regenerate it back, so short violent trades favor Sett once E is online at level 3. The one reversal is Demacian Justice (R) — a true-damage execute off missing HP — which means the lane is really about winning trades fast and resetting before you're low enough to die to it.

theirWindow.what: He can all-in with Decisive Strike (Q) silence into a full Judgment (E) spin. If he's clearly leveled a second point and you're still level 1, don't contest the wave in melee range — let it push and reset.

yourWindow.what: Step in and full-combo Q (Knuckle Down) into E (Facebreaker) into W (Haymaker). Without Judgment he has no spin damage or peel, and Perseverance can't out-heal a full burst landed in under two seconds.

start.why: The heal-on-hit passive sustains you through early auto trades against a champion whose own passive already heals him back between engagements.

boots.why: Blunts the repeated physical ticks from Judgment (E) spins and his empowered Decisive Strike (Q) auto, which are the bulk of his trade damage.

core.why: The slow on-hit and burst proc let you stick through his Decisive Strike (Q) speed boost and land full combos instead of poke.
The bonus-health shield absorbs a big instant hit, which directly counters getting finished by a stocked Demacian Justice (R).
Converts his physical burst into a DoT you heal back from, so extended spin-trades stop bleeding you out.

situational.when: the enemy team is snowballing and you need to survive dives after committing to fights
he builds attack speed/crit and his empowered autos start ticking too hard
their jungler or mid is a heavy magic-damage threat alongside Garen

runes.keystoneWhy: The adaptive force and healing on stacks reward the sustained melee trading this matchup is built around, and the heal helps you outlast Perseverance in extended fights.

summoners.why: Ghost matches Garen's Decisive Strike (Q) speed boost so you stay inside punching range through his kite attempts; Flash is your tool for landing Facebreaker (E) into a wall or escaping a stocked Demacian Justice (R).

playing.title: Don't out-spin Judgment
playing.detail: His E has no mana cost and its cooldown refunds on champion hit, so standing in it the whole duration just keeps it perpetually up. Take one or two ticks then reposition rather than trading through the full spin.

playing.title: Combo, don't poke
playing.detail: Land Q (Knuckle Down) into E (Facebreaker) into W (Haymaker) back to back. A few seconds of disengagement lets Perseverance heal him back to near full, erasing your poke.

playing.title: Time your Grit bar
playing.detail: Extend trades when your passive Pit Grit bar is close to full so the empowered auto lands mid-combo for extra damage instead of wasting it on a minion.

playing.title: Respect his level 2 spike
playing.detail: A level 2 Garen with Decisive Strike (Q) and Judgment (E) can punish a greedy level 1 trade. Ward and hold range if he's clearly ahead on levels.

playing.title: Disengage under 40% HP post-6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice (R) is a true-damage execute that scales with your missing health. Don't continue a trade at low HP once he has ult up — reset with Ghost or Sterak's shield instead.

playing.title: Wall your Facebreaker
playing.detail: Slamming him into terrain with E adds a stun on top of the knock-together damage, giving you a free empowered auto or a clean R follow-up.

playing.title: Freeze when ahead
playing.detail: Garen has no ranged wave-clear or poke beyond melee range, so freezing the wave near your tower after a won trade starves his farm and delays his items.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the post-mythic item system (Trinity Force / Sterak's Gage / Death's Dance core, Conqueror keystone) as of my training data — verify current names, costs, and numbers in client since both champions have received tuning passes since.
